# Shadow Checkers - English draughts opening book.
# One variation per line in PDN square numbers from the standard start (Black
# moves first). Lines are well-known openings / 3-move-ballot starts, trimmed
# where the engine's depth-9 analysis found a move clearly worse than the best
# alternative. Every line is replayed by the test suite (tests/test_ai.gd), and
# scripts/ai/checkers_book.gd embeds an identical copy for exported builds.
